speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to Dr. Agent's office; I need to understand your skin lesion to assess for any oncologic risks. Can you tell me where the spot is located on your body and how long it has been there? Additionally, has the size, color, or shape of the lesion changed recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Penile Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the finger (Cancer-associated skin lesions).
